page.overview:
What is Forostar?

Forostar, or the Northlands, was the northernmost province of Númenor.

It was a great north-pointing cape about 300 miles from base to tip, rising from infertile stony plains to chilly, windswept high-lands and ultimately towering sea-cliffs.

The land was largely devoid of trees and woodlands save for the area in the high heather-covered moors of the westward slopes, where there were woods of evergreen firs and seasonal larch trees.

The only named settlement in the province was Ondosto located in its south eastern quarter along the main road. A tower was built by Tar-Meneldur to observe the stars on the peak of Sorontil near the northern cape of the island, was also another noted feature of the province.
